warning.title: [perf] 2 render-blocking script(s) in <head>.
warning.why: Scripts in <head> without async/defer block rendering until fully downloaded and executed.
warning.fix: Add defer or async: <script defer src='script.js'>. Use defer for DOM-dependent, async for independent.

warning.title: [cwv] FCP is slow: 2.1s (target: <1.8s).
warning.why: FCP (First Contentful Paint) is when the user sees the first content. Slow FCP = users see a blank screen.
warning.impact: Users see nothing for 2.1s — increases bounce rate significantly.
warning.fix: Eliminate render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, preload key fonts, reduce server response time.
warning.estimatedGain: Faster first paint → lower bounce rate

warning.title: [cwv] Reduce unused JavaScript — Est savings of 25 KiB
warning.why: Google Lighthouse identified this as a significant performance opportunity.
warning.fix: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused JavaScript](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-javascript/).
